title: The interior-product covector ι_z(dy) with coordinates (−1)^i z_i
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ and z ∈ ℝ^{d+1} = Euclid (d+1). Write e_l := EuclideanSpace.single l 1 (l ∈ Fin (d+1)) for the standard basis and z_i for the i-th coordinate of z. Then there is a d-covector ε ∈ Covector (Euclid (d+1)) d (a continuous alternating d-linear form ℝ^{d+1} → ℝ) such that ε(i.removeNth e) = (−1)^i z_i for every i ∈ Fin (d+1). Here i.removeNth e = (e_{i.succAbove k})_{k ∈ Fin d} is the d-tuple (e_0, …, e_d) with e_i deleted.
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (z : Euclid (d + 1)), ∃ ε : Covector (Euclid (d + 1)) d, ∀ i : Fin (d + 1), ε (i.removeNth (fun l : Fin (d + 1) => EuclideanSpace.single l (1 : ℝ))) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (i : ℕ) * z i
